subject.title: docs(secrets): generate secretref reference docs from target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical implementation path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/44289?
rationale: The requested work remains valid, but this PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 overlap; the sibling has stronger proof and formatter shape but is currently conflicting, while this PR needs a correctness fix and stronger proof.

options.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
options.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, resolve conflicts, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Repair this PR
options.body: Ask this PR to derive annotations from matrix metadata, add formatter coverage and current-head proof, then refresh it against main before review.

options.title: Request a fresh replacement
options.body: Close or pause both competing branches and ask for one narrow replacement if neither branch is worth adopting.

recommendation.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
recommendation.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, resolve conflicts, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent SecretRef docs/matrix stabilization history makes steipete the best available routing owner for choosing the canonical branch.
